# Enitan Fiyinfoluwa Ajayi — Frontend Developer & Web Developer

Enitan Fiyinfoluwa Ajayi is a Computer Science student at Caleb University with hands-on experience in front-end web development, RESTful API integration, and IT support. She specializes in building modern, responsive web applications using React.js, Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and PHP.

## Primary Focus Areas
- Frontend Engineering & UI/UX (React.js, Vue.js, JavaScript ES6+, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap)
- API Integration & Dynamic Web Apps (RESTful APIs, JSON, Asynchronous Data Fetching)
- Backend & Database Integration (PHP, MySQL, CRUD Operations, Form Handling)
- IT Infrastructure & Networking (IP Addressing, DHCP, Routers, Switches, Hyper-V Virtualization)
- Design & Prototyping (Canva / Graphic Design, Wireframing, Component-Driven Architecture)

## Key Projects
- NovaMart: Responsive modern e-commerce web platform with product filtering, dynamic cart state management, and PHP backend order processing.
- PulseTrack: Interactive healthcare appointment and vital statistics monitoring dashboard featuring Chart.js analytics and REST API data feeds.
- FlowTask: Collaborative task management platform with customizable workflow boards and persistent PHP/MySQL storage.
- SwiftNews & Weather Portal: Fast, API-driven information portal aggregating live multi-service headlines with instant search.
